title: addMonths

spec.text: addMonths(date, n) returns a new Date n calendar months later in UTC, keeping the time of day. If the target month is shorter, clamp to its last day (Jan 31 + 1 month is Feb 28, or Feb 29 in a leap year). n may be negative; a non-integer n is a programming error. The input Date must not be mutated.

context: Used to compute subscription renewal dates. All dates are UTC billing dates between 2000 and 2100.
